verses.original: עַתָּה֙ תִּתְגֹּדְדִ֣י בַת־ גְּד֔וּד מָצ֖וֹר שָׂ֣ם עָלֵ֑ינוּ בַּשֵּׁ֙בֶט֙ יַכּ֣וּ עַֽל־ הַלְּחִ֔י אֵ֖ת שֹׁפֵ֥ט יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh tiṯ·gō·ḏə·ḏî ḇaṯ- gə·ḏūḏ mā·ṣō·wr śām ‘ā·lê·nū baš·šê·ḇeṭ yak·kū ‘al- hal·lə·ḥî ’êṯ šō·p̄êṭ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now O daughter of troops mobilize your troops for a siege is laid against us With a rod they will strike the cheek of the judge of Israel
verses.literalPt: AGORA ajunta-te em tropas, ó filha de tropas; pôr-se-á cerco contra nós; ferirão com a vara na face ao juiz de Israel.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה בֵּֽית־ לֶ֣חֶם אֶפְרָ֗תָה צָעִיר֙ לִֽהְיוֹת֙ בְּאַלְפֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה מִמְּךָ֙ לִ֣י יֵצֵ֔א לִֽהְי֥וֹת מוֹשֵׁ֖ל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּמוֹצָאֹתָ֥יו מִקֶּ֖דֶם מִימֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh bêṯ- le·ḥem ’ep̄·rā·ṯāh ṣā·‘îr lih·yō·wṯ bə·’al·p̄ê yə·hū·ḏāh mim·mə·ḵā lî yê·ṣê lih·yō·wṯ mō·wō·šêl bə·yiś·rā·’êl ū·mō·w·ṣā·’ō·ṯāw miq·qe·ḏem mî·mê ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: But you Bethlehem Ephrathah who are small among the clans of Judah out of you will come forth for Me One to be ruler over Israel One whose origins are of old from the days of eternity
verses.literalPt: E tu, Belém Efrata, posto que pequena entre os milhares de Judá, de ti me sairá o que governará em Israel, e cujas saídas são desde os tempos antigos, desde os dias da eternidade.

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן יִתְּנֵ֔ם עַד־ עֵ֥ת יוֹלֵדָ֖ה יָלָ֑דָה וְיֶ֣תֶר אֶחָ֔יו יְשׁוּב֖וּן עַל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên yit·tə·nêm ‘aḏ- ‘êṯ yō·w·lê·ḏāh yā·lā·ḏāh wə·ye·ṯer ’e·ḥāw yə·šū·ḇūn ‘al- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Therefore Israel will be abandoned until . . . she who is in labor has given birth then the rest of His brothers will return to the children of Israel
verses.literalPt: Portanto os entregará até ao tempo em que a que está de parto tiver dado à luz; então o restante de seus irmãos voltará aos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וְעָמַ֗ד וְרָעָה֙ בְּעֹ֣ז יְהוָ֔ה בִּגְא֕וֹן שֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו וְיָשָׁ֕בוּ כִּֽי־ עַתָּ֥ה יִגְדַּ֖ל עַד־ אַפְסֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·maḏ wə·rā·‘āh bə·‘ōz Yah·weh biḡ·’ō·wn šêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw wə·yā·šā·ḇū kî- ‘at·tāh yiḡ·dal ‘aḏ- ’ap̄·sê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: He will stand and shepherd His flock in the strength of the LORD in the majestic name of the LORD His God And they will dwell securely for then His greatness will extend to the ends of the earth
verses.literalPt: E ele permanecerá, e apascentará ao povo na força do SENHOR, na excelência do nome do SENHOR seu Deus; e eles permanecerão, porque agora será engrandecido até aos fins da terra.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֥ה זֶ֖ה שָׁל֑וֹם אַשּׁ֣וּר׀ כִּֽי־ יָב֣וֹא בְאַרְצֵ֗נוּ וְכִ֤י יִדְרֹךְ֙ בְּאַרְמְנֹתֵ֔ינוּ וַהֲקֵמֹ֤נוּ עָלָיו֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה רֹעִ֔ים וּשְׁמֹנָ֖ה נְסִיכֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh zeh šā·lō·wm ’aš·šūr kî- yā·ḇō·w ḇə·’ar·ṣê·nū wə·ḵî yiḏ·rōḵ bə·’ar·mə·nō·ṯê·nū wa·hă·qê·mō·nū ‘ā·lāw šiḇ·‘āh rō·‘îm ū·šə·mō·nāh nə·sî·ḵê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: And He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and tramples our citadels We will raise against it seven shepherds even eight leaders of men
verses.literalPt: E este será a nossa paz; quando a Assíria vier à nossa terra, e quando pisar em nossos palácios, levantaremos contra ela sete pastores e oito príncipes dentre os homens.

verses.original: וְרָע֞וּ אֶת־ אֶ֤רֶץ אַשּׁוּר֙ בַּחֶ֔רֶב וְאֶת־ אֶ֥רֶץ נִמְרֹ֖ד בִּפְתָחֶ֑יהָ וְהִצִּיל֙ מֵֽאַשּׁ֔וּר כִּֽי־ יָב֣וֹא בְאַרְצֵ֔נוּ וְכִ֥י יִדְרֹ֖ךְ בִּגְבוּלֵֽנוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·‘ū ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ ’aš·šūr ba·ḥe·reḇ wə·’eṯ- ’e·reṣ nim·rōḏ bip̄·ṯā·ḥe·hā wə·hiṣ·ṣîl mê·’aš·šūr kî- yā·ḇō·w ḇə·’ar·ṣê·nū wə·ḵî yiḏ·rōḵ biḡ·ḇū·lê·nū
verses.literal: And they will rule the land of Assyria with the sword and the land of Nimrod with the blade drawn So He will deliver us when Assyria invades our land and marches into our borders
verses.literalPt: Esses consumirão a terra da Assíria à espada, e a terra de Ninrode nas suas entradas. Assim nos livrará da Assíria, quando vier à nossa terra, e quando calcar os nossos termos.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֗ב בְּקֶ֙רֶב֙ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים כְּטַל֙ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה כִּרְבִיבִ֖ים עֲלֵי־ עֵ֑שֶׂב אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ יְקַוֶּה֙ לְאִ֔ישׁ וְלֹ֥א יְיַחֵ֖ל לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh šə·’ê·rîṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ bə·qe·reḇ ‘am·mîm rab·bîm kə·ṭal mê·’êṯ Yah·weh kir·ḇî·ḇîm ‘ă·lê- ‘ê·śeḇ ’ă·šer lō- yə·qaw·weh lə·’îš wə·lō yə·ya·ḥêl liḇ·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Then the remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD like showers on the grass which do not wait for man or linger for mankind . . .
verses.literalPt: E o remanescente de Jacó estará no meio de muitos povos, como orvalho da parte do SENHOR, como chuvisco sobre a erva, que não espera pelo homem, nem aguarda a filhos de homens.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ שְׁאֵרִ֨ית יַעֲקֹ֜ב בַּגּוֹיִ֗ם בְּקֶ֙רֶב֙ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים כְּאַרְיֵה֙ בְּבַהֲמ֣וֹת יַ֔עַר כִּכְפִ֖יר בְּעֶדְרֵי צֹ֑אן אֲשֶׁ֧ר אִם עָבַ֛ר וְרָמַ֥ס וְטָרַ֖ף וְאֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh šə·’ê·rîṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ bag·gō·w·yim bə·qe·reḇ ‘am·mîm rab·bîm kə·’ar·yêh bə·ḇa·hă·mō·wṯ ya·‘ar kiḵ·p̄îr bə·ʿɛḏ·rē ṣōn ’ă·šer ’im ‘ā·ḇar wə·rā·mas wə·ṭā·rap̄ wə·’ên maṣ·ṣîl
verses.literal: Then the remnant of Jacob will be among the nations in the midst of many peoples like a lion among the beasts of the forest like a young lion among flocks of sheep which tramples and tears as it passes through with no one to rescue them
verses.literalPt: E o restante de Jacó estará entre os gentios, no meio de muitos povos, como um leão entre os animais do bosque, como um leãozinho entre os rebanhos de ovelhas, o qual, quando passar, pisará e despedaçará, sem que haja quem as livre.

verses.original: תָּרֹ֥ם יָדְךָ֖ עַל־ צָרֶ֑יךָ וְכָל־ אֹיְבֶ֖יךָ יִכָּרֵֽתוּ׃פ
verses.literal: Your hand will be lifted over your foes and all your enemies will be cut off
verses.literalPt: A tua mão se exaltará sobre os teus adversários; e todos os teus inimigos serão exterminados.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה בַיּוֹם־ הַהוּא֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י סוּסֶ֖יךָ מִקִּרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֖י מַרְכְּבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḇay·yō·wm- ha·hū nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·hiḵ·rat·tî sū·se·ḵā miq·qir·be·ḵā wə·ha·’ă·ḇaḏ·tî mar·kə·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: In that day declares the LORD I will remove your horses from among you and wreck your chariots
verses.literalPt: E sucederá naquele dia, diz o SENHOR, que eu exterminarei do meio de ti os teus cavalos, e destruirei os teus carros.

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֖י עָרֵ֣י אַרְצֶ֑ךָ וְהָרַסְתִּ֖י כָּל־ מִבְצָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.literal: I will remove the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds
verses.literalPt: E destruirei as cidades da tua terra, e derrubarei todas as tuas fortalezas;

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י כְשָׁפִ֖ים מִיָּדֶ֑ךָ וּֽמְעוֹנְנִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִֽהְיוּ־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḵ·rat·tî ḵə·šā·p̄îm mî·yā·ḏe·ḵā ū·mə·‘ō·wn·nîm lō yih·yū- lāḵ
verses.literal: I will cut the sorceries from your hand and you will have no fortune-tellers
verses.literalPt: E exterminarei as feitiçarias da tua mão; e não terás adivinhadores;

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֧י פְסִילֶ֛יךָ וּמַצֵּבוֹתֶ֖יךָ מִקִּרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְלֹֽא־ תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה ע֖וֹד לְמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḵ·rat·tî p̄ə·sî·le·ḵā ū·maṣ·ṣê·ḇō·w·ṯe·ḵā miq·qir·be·ḵā wə·lō- ṯiš·ta·ḥă·weh ‘ō·wḏ lə·ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: I will also cut off the carved images and sacred pillars from among you so that you will no longer bow down to the work of your own hands
verses.literalPt: E destruirei do meio de ti as tuas imagens de escultura e as tuas estátuas; e tu não te inclinarás mais diante da obra das tuas mãos.

verses.literal: I will root out the Asherah poles from your midst and demolish your cities
verses.literalPt: E arrancarei os teus bosques do meio de ti; e destruirei as tuas cidades.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתִי בְּאַ֧ף וּבְחֵמָ֛ה נָקָ֖ם אֶת־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯî bə·’ap̄ ū·ḇə·ḥê·māh nā·qām ’eṯ- hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer lō šā·mê·‘ū
verses.literal: I will take vengeance . . . in anger and wrath upon the nations that have not obeyed Me
verses.literalPt: E com ira e com furor farei vingança sobre os gentios que não ouvem.
